cohort: 239 females who had undergone two or more Cesarean sections between 2015-2018
finding: Women undergoing Cesarean sections with risk factors such as increased body mass index, dense adhesions, uterine atony, hypertension and presence of placenta previa, were found to be at increased risk for a need for blood transfusions.
mod_finding: Women with more than two previous cesarean sections had a higher proportion of blood transfusions compared to those with two, but the difference was not statistically significant.
